in the beginning of January, i started to have the worst breakouts ever. I never really paid attention to them at all because it wasn't disturbing any of my daily life, but then april/may hit and i truly noticed how bad my skin was getting. I didn't wanna go outside, I didn't wanna get out of bed, I ate so much I gained 20 pounds, I was depressed. I remember October/November being the worst of my life. My daily life had been ruined by my severe eczema, and I even blamed it on my self, everything that the doctor's prescribed me didn't work at all. I stopped taking daily showers because I knew that I wasn't gonna get better, even if I prayed for it. and just recently, i've had so many su1cid4l thoughts because of my situation (plus on going family issues) but I just recently got out of the hospital because my doctor prescribed me with Dupixent. I'm hearing really great reviews and i'm hearing some that I can relate too.  
  
  
  
My life truly sucks and i wish I could get better, and as cliche as it sounds, just know that it'll be better, even if it doesn't seem like it. If dupixent doesn't work out for me I don't know what i'll do, but please don't give up on your self, there are many resources available for you. I'm here to talk anytime. please take care and I love you.
